title: Surreal Melting Dreamscape
description: A surreal painting depicts a large floating island with a gnarled tree and dripping clocks above a starry night sky with comets. Below, a split-face portrait with blue tears merges with a melting green dog, a blue starry river, wilting plants, and gravestones labeled 'MEMORY', 'TIME', 'REGRET', and 'MYSTERY'.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting featuring a massive floating island with a twisted tree and melting clocks dripping liquid, a starry blue river flowing through the sky, a large split-tone woman's face with blue tears, a melting green dog with orange drips, wilting plants, broken clocks, and multiple gravestones labeled MEMORY, TIME, REGRET and MYSTERY set in dark soil under a comet-filled night sky.
